The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0fee79cbeaa3ae4f), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 9. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the data of Theorem 4.2, with s > 0, there is a projective contraction f : N → C and an effective horizontal rational boundary H such that: (i) N is Q-factorial, its generic fibre is geometrically integral and birational to V , and (N, T + H) is dlt, where T = (f∗c)red; (ii) KN + T + H ∼Q,C 0; (iii) for the same field-theoretic form Ω and w = wz(ϕ), there is an equality of rational divisors near T, 1 m divN (Ω) + T + H = wf∗ c. (4.8) In particular, on the generic fibre, div(ϕ)+mHη = 0. If H has no coefficient-one component, then (Nη, Hη) is geometrically klt and KNη is Q-Cartier.
